SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No.
Section 1, Special Branch    61404
REPORT    Date January 9, 1940
Subject. Mrs.V.Livanoff alias Victoria Seou - present activities.
Made by... D.S.I. Prokofiev.    Forwarded by...

Information has been received to the effect
that Mrs. V.LIVANOFF alias Victoria SEOU etc.,who forms
the subject of Special Branch file D-6578,is at present
operating,under the name of Mrs.E.V.P.TOLL,an enterprise
known as the"SHANGHAI BUREAU OF BUSINESS SERVICE" with
an office at 159 Peking Road,2nd Floor ( Tel.19066 ).
The enterprise is reported to have been established some
time during 1939 and at first was located at 88 Nanking
Road in a room of the office occupied by Clarke's In-
quiry & Protection Agency. In November last it was re-
moved to its present address.
No information is available so far regarding
the exact nature of the business conducted by Mrs.Toll.
It appears to be an employment bureau,but there are rea-
sons to believe that it undertakes other kinds of busi-
ness as well.
It will be recalled that Toll was the name of
Mrs. Livanoff's second husband.

收到情报称，V. LIVANOFF 夫人（化名 Victoria SEOU 等），即特务科档案 D-6578 的对象，目前以 E.V.P. TOLL 夫人的名义经营一家名为“上海商业服务局”（SHANGHAI BUREAU OF BUSINESS SERVICE）的企业，办公地点位于北京路159号二楼（电话 19066）。
据报该企业于1939年某时成立，起初位于南京路88号 Clarke 调查与保护代理公司所占用的办公室内的一个房间。去年11月，它迁至现址。
目前尚无关于 Toll 夫人所经营业务确切性质的情报。它看似一家职业介绍所，但有理由相信它也从事其他类型的业务。
需指出的是，Toll 是 Livanoff 夫人第二任丈夫的姓氏。

Subject... Article of the "Novosti Dnia" dated 26-2-37 concerning alleged
existence in Shanghai of the "Salon of Love", house of ill-fame.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by J. Boyne. D.S.I.

Enquiries have failed to prove the allegation
regarding the existence in Shanghai of a house of ill-fame
under the name of the "Salon of Love", where business is con-
ducted on the lines indicated in the attached translation from
the "Novosti Dnia" dated 26-2-37.

The editor of the "Novosti Dnia" has been unable
to furnish any further information on the subject. In this con-
nection it should be borne in mind that on account of this news-
paper's crave for sensation its information cannot be regarded
as very reliable.

On the other hand, rumours have it that Mrs V. Li-
vanoff alias Lily Desmonde alias Victoria Seou etc. is not
above suspicion in this respect. This individual is the pro-
prietress of a brothel at No 237 Dixwell Road (Chinese terri-
tory). The information she volunteered during the course of a
conversation with two police officers in January, 1936 (vide
report dated 13-1-36) seems to corroborate the suspicions
against her. However, no tangible evidence is so far available.

It has been learned privately that enquiries made
into this matter by the French Police have failed to substanti-
ate the allegation of the "Novosti Dnia".

G. Prokofiev
D. S. I.

主题…… 《今日新闻》（Novosti Dnia）1937年2月26日文章，关于上海存在所谓“爱之沙龙”（Salon of Love），即妓院的说法。

制作人 D.S.I. Prokofiev。转呈人 J. Boyne. D.S.I.

经查询，未能证实关于上海存在一家名为“爱之沙龙”的妓院的说法，其经营模式如附带的1937年2月26日《今日新闻》译文中所述。

《今日新闻》编辑无法就此主题提供更多信息。在此需注意的是，鉴于该报纸追求轰动效应，其消息不能被视为非常可靠。

另一方面，有谣言称 V. Livanoff 夫人（化名 Lily Desmonde，化名 Victoria Seou 等）在这方面并非没有嫌疑。此人是位于狄思威路237号（华界）一家妓院的老板娘。她在1936年1月与两名警官谈话期间自愿提供的信息（参见1936年1月13日的报告）似乎佐证了对她的怀疑。然而，目前尚无确凿证据。

私下获悉，法国警察对此事的调查也未能证实《今日新闻》的说法。

Translation from Russian newspaper NOVOSTI DNIA, January 26,
1927. Published by the Russian Publishing Co., 630 Avenue
Foch. Editor - Mr. A.I. Veiss.

HAVE YOU RECEIVED A TELEPHONE CALL
FROM THE "SALON OF LOVE"?

Allow us to give you a brief description.

R-r-ring.... R-r-ring.... R-r-ring....
The telephone receiver is picked up.
- Hello?
- Yes.
- I am speaking from the salon.
- What salon?
- The "Salon of Love". It is the latest word of the gay Shang-
hai. Madam, we have here the most handsome men in Shanghai,
full of sex appeal. With them you can experience every plea-
sure. Our address is.....

Further conversation depends on the character of the lady who
receives the call. If she likes exciting thrills, she will make
a note of the address and ask again the number of the house in
order to make sure. If she is indignant over the insolence of
the caller, she will hang up the receiver.

The above dialogue is not a phantasy. Unfortunately, it is the
dreadful and bitter reality of the dissolute Shanghai. Tele-
phone calls and offers of this nature have by no means been a
rarity in Shanghai since some time of late.

Preference is given to Russian ladies who are married to wealthy
foreigners.

The offers are made in Russian and, judging from certain details,
the master mind of this disgusting novelty is, unfortunately, a
Russian who in the past was a great specialist in organizing
similar dens.

It is to be hoped that the Police will be informed of the ad-
dress of the "Salon of Love" and that an end will be put to the
existence of the abominable establishment disgracing our city,
while its organizers will be requested to leave the city.

Translator's note: Mr. A.I. Veiss, the editor of the
NOVOSTI DNIA has been communicated with. He is unable to give
the address of the place referred to in the above translation,
but promised to let the Police know, as soon as he has received
some definite information.

G. Prokofiew
D.S.I.

接下来的对话取决于接听电话的女士的性格。如果她喜欢刺激的惊险感，她会记下地址，并再次询问门牌号以确认。如果她对来电者的无礼感到愤怒，她会挂断电话。

上述对话并非幻想。不幸的是，这是堕落上海的可怕而苦涩的现实。近来，这种性质的电话和提议在上海绝非罕见。

优先考虑嫁给富裕外国人的俄国女士。

提议是用俄语发出的，从某些细节判断，这一令人厌恶的新奇事物的幕后主使，不幸的是一位俄国人，他过去曾是组织类似窝点的大专家。

With reference to this enquiry, on Saturday last I
visited the Chung Woo Building at 320 Nanking Road in order to
interview the woman advertising as a clairvoyant.
The occupant of Flat 216 is a Chinese doctor named
Lew Ding ( 刘 J ). It has been sub-divided by the use of
partitions into a small entrance hall which serves as an office,
a doctor's surgery and a small cubicle. This cubicle is
sub-let by the doctor to the advertiser. The doctor was
inclined to be conversational and tried to get a few particulars
from me, probably with the idea of passing them on to the
fortune-teller. I intimated that my visit was made at the
instance of a lady friend who desired to have her fortune told,
but first of all required to know a few particulars such as the
nationality of the palmist, her scale of charges etc.
Although I arrived but shortly before 11 a.m. the
crystal-gazer had still not reached the office. She turned up
at about 11.20 a.m., but did not enter straight away. Apparently
someone met her outside in the passage and informed her that a
client was waiting, for I was invited by the doctor to step into
the surgery while she passed by into the cubicle. Probably she
thought that much of the mystery surrounding her profession
would be lost if prospective clients saw her in street attire.
A few minutes after she had entered her den I was ushered in.
The electricity had been switched off and the place was dimly
lighted by candles set in a brass sconce. On a table in one
corner of the room a human skull grinned at one, while arranged

Sir,
I have to report that Mrs. Livanoff alias Madam Janette
alias Victoria Scott alias Madam Dafin Desmond alias Dauphine
Desmonde put for public showing on the evening of the 27-7-30
at Paris Theatre, "Prestidigitation," under the name of the
latter alias, assisted by T.E. Rosario, a Portuguese.
Act I consisted of being handcuffed and placed into a
trunk, which was locked and roped, and placed behind a curtained
stand. After a period of five minutes places were exchanged
by her and Rosario.
Act II. Dauphine Desmonde appears on the stage in a
bathing costume and is chained about the body, handcuffed and
legironed, placed behind the said mentioned curtain, and after
a period of five minutes, extricated herself.
Act III. Rosario appears as a magician, with a wand and
a pack of cards, he distributes cards about the audience, then
calls for a card and at the same time will draw the corresponding
card from the pack.
Act IV. Dauphine Desmonde appears as a witch and with the
assistance of Rosario, is able to tell what is being produced,
in the form of money, articles and writings.
The handcuffs which are used, are of the S.M.P. type, large
size, and Dauphine Desmonde's hands being very small she is able
to remove them very easily. As to the trunk, it is the usual sort
with a sliding panel, the undersigned was able to obtain a
good view for when assistants were called for from the audience,
the undersigned went on the stage.

先生，
兹报告如下：利瓦诺夫夫人（Mrs. Livanoff），又名珍妮特夫人（Madam Janette），又名维多利亚·斯科特（Victoria Scott），又名达芬·德斯蒙德夫人（Madam Dafin Desmond），又名多菲娜·德斯蒙德（Dauphine Desmonde），于1930年7月27日晚在巴黎剧院以最后一个别名名义公开表演“魔术戏法”，由葡萄牙人 T.E. 罗萨里奥（T.E. Rosario）协助。
第一幕包括被戴上手铐并放入一个箱子，箱子被锁上并用绳子捆好，然后放在一个挂着帘子的架子后面。五分钟后，她和罗萨里奥交换了位置。
第二幕。多菲娜·德斯蒙德身穿泳装出现在舞台上，身体被链条束缚，戴着手铐和脚镣，被带到上述帘子后面，五分钟后，她挣脱了出来。
第三幕。罗萨里奥作为魔术师出现，手持魔杖和一副纸牌，他向观众分发纸牌，然后要求抽出一张牌，同时他从牌堆中抽出相应的那张牌。
第四幕。多菲娜·德斯蒙德扮作女巫，在罗萨里奥的协助下，能够说出以金钱、物品和文字形式呈现的内容。
使用的手铐是工部局警务处（S.M.P.）型的大号手铐，由于多菲娜·德斯蒙德的手非常小，她能很容易地脱掉它们。至于那个箱子，是那种带有滑动面板的普通类型，当从观众中招募助手时，签署人走上舞台，得以清楚地观察内部情况。

May 6, 1930.

Mrs. Victoria Eugenie Livanoff alias Madan Canette alias
Victoria Seou.

With reference to the attached anonymous letter,
inquiries show that Mrs. Victoria Eugenie Livanoff alias
Madan Janette alias Victoria Seou is a fortune teller and
actress. She is a native of Varsovie and was born in 1893.
It is said that she has been married four times. The first
husband was Mr. Korkine, a Russian officer, who was killed
during the Great War, Second, Baron Toll killed during
revolution. Third, Captain Koishi Senoo of the Japanese
Army, who perished in 1923 during the earthquake in Japan. She
married her present husband, Mr. N.N. Livanoff in 1924 at
Shanghai. She left Russia in 1918 and until 1923 lived in
Harbin and Japan, and has visited most of the big towns in
China, including Shanghai, Tientsin, Hankow, Hongkong and
Canton. She has a bad reputation and it is reported that
information obtained through fortune telling is used for
blackmailing her clients. She also acts as a "go between"
for men and women for immoral purposes.

Mr. Bruce, Manager of Shanghai Mercury Ltd, 14 Foochow
Road, whose name is mentioned in this anonymous letter, knew
Mrs. Seou in Tientsin as a woman of bad reputation and was
believed to be trafficking in women. Miss Fuller, British,
employed in the "Mercury" knew Mrs. Seou in Harbin in 1928
and came under Mrs. Seou's influence there. Mrs. Seou decided
that they should leave Harbin for Shanghai, but before leaving
Harbin, she took all Miss Fuller's money and clothes, and
tried to change her British passport for a Chinese one. At
Dairen Miss Fuller escaped from Mrs. Seou and made a complaint
to the Japanese Police and British Consul. Before the
Japanese Police could take action Mrs. Seou left Dairen.

1930年5月6日。

维多利亚·尤金妮·利瓦诺夫（Victoria Eugenie Livanoff）夫人，又名马丹·卡内特（Madan Canette），又名维多利亚·修（Victoria Seou）。

关于所附匿名信，经查，维多利亚·尤金妮·利瓦诺夫夫人，又名马丹·贾内特（Madan Janette），又名维多利亚·修，是一名算命师和演员。她原籍华沙（Varsovie），生于1893年。据说她曾结过四次婚。第一任丈夫是科尔金（Korkine）先生，一名俄国军官，在第一次世界大战期间阵亡；第二任丈夫是托尔（Toll）男爵，在革命期间被杀；第三任丈夫是日本陆军的小石仙雄（Koishi Senoo）大尉，于1923年日本大地震中丧生。她于1924年在上海与现任丈夫N.N.利瓦诺夫（N.N. Livanoff）先生结婚。她于1918年离开俄国，直至1923年居住在哈尔滨和日本，并曾游历中国大多数大城市，包括上海、天津、汉口、香港和广州。她名声不佳，据报她利用算命获取的信息来勒索客户。她还为男女之间进行不道德目的的牵线搭桥。

福州路14号《上海水星报》（Shanghai Mercury Ltd）经理布鲁斯（Bruce）先生，其名字在这封匿名信中被提及，他在天津认识修夫人，认为她是一个名声不好的女人，涉嫌贩卖妇女。受雇于《水星报》的英国籍富勒（Fuller）小姐于1928年在哈尔滨认识修夫人，并在那里受到修夫人的影响。修夫人决定她们应离开哈尔滨前往上海，但在离开哈尔滨之前，她拿走了富勒小姐所有的钱物和衣物，并试图将她的英国护照换成中国护照。在大连，富勒小姐从修夫人处逃脱，并向日本警察和英国领事提出控告。在日本警察采取行动之前，修夫人离开了大连。

page_data.en:
- 2

Miss Fuller knows that Mrs. Seou swindled many other girls
by promising them to regain their lost sweethearts etc. by
her magic powers.
Quite probably the anonymous letter has been written
by Miss Fuller who has sufficient reason to dislike Mrs. Seou.
Mr. Fog who is also mentioned in this letter is a Dane and
resides at 2 Route Grouchy and has an office at No. 2A Kiukiang
Road, where he carries on a fur merchants business. Fog
recommended Mrs. Seou for a British visa to enable her to
proceed to Singapore and Colombo.
Mrs. Seou is in possession of a German visa and her
intention is to proceed to Berlin, Germany. She intends to
give some performance on her way to Germany which is the reason
she has applied for a Netherlands visa for Dutch East Indies.
She also applied for British visa for Singapore and Colombo.
It is not known that Mrs. Seou is connected with Bolshevik
Communistic activities.
Her husband, Mr. Nikolas Nikolaevich Livanoff,
residing at 59 Avenue Road, is a native if Varsovie, born in
1903, was educated at Habarovsk Cadet Corps School. He left
Russia from Vladivostock in 1922 for Shanghai and was employed
here by the Russian Cadet Corps as assistant tutor. In 1923
he left for Canton where he was employed by the Portuguese River
Police. In 1924 he returned to Shanghai and set up a small
electric contractors business which lasted for about 6 months.
Afterwards he assisted his wife in her business of Fortune
telling. He is much junior to her and it is said he is absolute
under her influence. It is not known that he is in any way
connected with Bolshevik.
Enquiries show that neither have been convicted
in the International Settlement or French Concession.
page_data.zh:
- 2

富勒小姐知道修夫人通过承诺用其魔力帮助许多其他女孩找回失去的情人等手段来诈骗她们。
这封匿名信很可能是富勒小姐写的，她有充分的理由讨厌修夫人。
信中提到的福格（Fog）先生是一名丹麦人，居住在格鲁希路（Route Grouchy）2号，并在九江路2A号设有办公室，经营皮草商业务。福格曾为修夫人申请英国签证提供推荐，以便她前往新加坡和科伦坡。
修夫人持有德国签证，打算前往德国柏林。她计划在前往德国的途中进行一些表演，这就是她申请荷属东印度群岛的荷兰签证的原因。她还申请了前往新加坡和科伦坡的英国签证。
目前尚不知晓修夫人与布尔什维克共产主义活动有关联。
她的丈夫尼古拉斯·尼古拉耶维奇·利瓦诺夫（Nikolas Nikolaevich Livanoff）先生，居住在爱文义路（Avenue Road）59号，原籍华沙，生于1903年，曾在哈巴罗夫斯克士官武备学校（Habarovsk Cadet Corps School）受教育。他于1922年从符拉迪沃斯托克（Vladivostock）离开俄国前往上海，在此受雇于俄国士官武备团担任助理教员。1923年他前往广州，受雇于葡萄牙水警。1924年他回到上海，开办了一家小型电气承包商行，维持了约6个月。此后他协助妻子从事算命生意。他比她年轻得多，据说完全受她支配。目前尚不知晓他与布尔什维克有任何关联。
调查显示，两人在公共租界或法租界均未被定罪。

page_data.en:
C O P Y.
----------

This is a Russian woman and her husband
known as Mrs. Victoria Seou from Harbin and yrs
in French Concession. She is working against the
British and her agencies in Calcutta. Her friend a big Dane
named Foc or Fock, is her No. 1 man. She also imports
girls from Harbin, Russian Siberia on commission.
Refer to Bruce of Times newspaper and he known of her
from Tientsin.

About 5 wks ago she left Ave Joffre house
and moves every few wks, now is trying to purchase
a passport to get to Hongkong, has a husband young cadet
boy to " and Calcutta is her object now.

With a few glasses of drinks in she tells
lots. from one who know she is a trouble maker and
Bolshevik she is Polish Jew only Ruskey by marriage.
page_data.zh:
副本。
----------

这是一个俄国女人和她的丈夫，
来自哈尔滨，在法租界住了几年，
被称为维多利亚·修夫人。她正在对抗
英国及其在加尔各答的机构。她的朋友，一个名叫
福克（Foc 或 Fock）的大个子丹麦人，是她的头号人物。她还
从哈尔滨、俄属西伯利亚佣金引进女孩。
可询问《泰晤士报》（Times newspaper）的布鲁斯，他在
天津就了解她。

大约5周前她离开了霞飞路（Ave Joffre）的住所，
每隔几周就搬家，现在正试图购买
一本护照以前往香港，有个年轻的士官生
丈夫要“……”而加尔各答是她现在的目标。

喝了几杯酒之后，她就
滔滔不绝。据知情者称，她是个麻烦制造者和
布尔什维克，她是波兰犹太人，只是通过婚姻成为俄国人。

actress. She is a native of Varsovie and was born in 1893.
It is said that she has been married four times. The first
husband was Mr. Korkine, a Russian officer, who was killed
during the Great War. Second, Baron Toll killed during
Revolution. Third, Captain Koishi Senoo of the Japanese Army,
who perished in 1923 during the earthquake in Japan. She
married her present husband, Mr. N.N. Livanoff in 1924 at
Shanghai. She left Russia in 1918 and until 1923 lived in
Harbin and Japan, and has visited most of the big towns in
China, including Shanghai, Tientsin, Hankow, Hongkong and
Canton. She has a bad reputation and it is reported that
information obtained through fortune telling is used for
blackmailing her clients. She also acts as a "go between"
for men and women for immoral purposes.
Mr. Bruge, Manager of Shanghai Mercury Ltd, 14 Foochow
Road, whose name is mentioned in this anonymous letter, knew
Mrs. Seou in Tientsin as a woman of bad reputation and was
believed to be trafficking in women. Miss Fuller, British,
employed in the "Mercury" knew Mrs. Seou in Harbin in 1928
and came under Mrs. Seou's influence there. Mrs. Seou decided
that they should leave Harbin for Shanghai, but before leaving
Harbin, she took all Miss Fuller's money and clothes, and
tried to change her British passport for a Chinese one. At
Dairen Miss Fuller escaped from Mrs. Seou and made a complaint
to the Japanese Police and British Consul. Before the
Japanese Police could take action Mrs. Seou left Dairen.

关于所附匿名信，经查，维多利亚·尤金妮·利瓦诺夫夫人，又名马丹·贾内特，又名维多利亚·修，是一名算命师和演员。她原籍华沙（Varsovie），生于1893年。据说她曾结过四次婚。第一任丈夫是科尔金（Korkine）先生，一名俄国军官，在第一次世界大战期间阵亡。第二任丈夫是托尔（Toll）男爵，在革命期间被杀。第三任丈夫是日本陆军的小石仙雄（Koishi Senoo）大尉，于1923年日本大地震中丧生。她于1924年在上海与现任丈夫N.N.利瓦诺夫先生结婚。她于1918年离开俄国，直至1923年居住在哈尔滨和日本，并曾游历中国大多数大城市，包括上海、天津、汉口、香港和广州。她名声不佳，据报她利用算命获取的信息来勒索客户。她还为男女之间进行不道德目的的牵线搭桥。
福州路14号《上海水星报》有限公司经理布鲁吉（Bruge）先生，其名字在这封匿名信中被提及，他在天津认识修夫人，认为她是一个名声不好的女人，涉嫌贩卖妇女。受雇于《水星报》的英国籍富勒（Fuller）小姐于1928年在哈尔滨认识修夫人，并在那里受到修夫人的影响。修夫人决定她们应离开哈尔滨前往上海，但在离开哈尔滨之前，她拿走了富勒小姐所有的钱物和衣物，并试图将她的英国护照换成中国护照。在大连，富勒小姐从修夫人处逃脱，并向日本警察和英国领事提出控告。在日本警察采取行动之前，修夫人离开了大连。

escaped leaving un-paid accounts to the extent of about
One hundred and sixty dollars Mex; and in explanation I
enclose copy of a letter sent by me to Mr. Dunn.

You are doubtless aware of the nondescript
and unconstitutional status of the Kuling Estate, and the
almost complete impotence of their Police Authority to
protect residents there.

Mr. Dunn notified me that he was applying for
a Warrant from the Chinese Authorities, and that the Ins-
pector of Police in Kuling was sending you details of the
charge made against the Livanoff's, and also information
regarding several jewelry robberies there.

I have however received no confirmation from

exceed the action I have already taken, and I have recom-
mended Mr. Dunn to place the matter in the hands of a
Shanghai Barrister so as to communicate with you direct if
desired.

I have also advised Mr. Dunn that the Livanoffs

Date February 26, 40.

Subject. Mrs. V. Livanoff alias Victoria Seou alias Mrs. E.V.F. Toll -
present activities.

Made by. D. S. I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by. D.I. Crawford.

Inquiries regarding the exact nature of business conducted by Mrs. Toll at the "Shanghai Bureau of Business Service", 159 Peking Road, show that the Bureau shares an office on the second floor of the building with two small Chinese firms - Ah Wong & Co. and Nong Young & Co., and pays $30 per month for the part of the office it occupies. Otherwise there seems to be no connection between the Bureau and these firms.

The enterprise is operated as an employment bureau. When registering with the Bureau applicants for employment pay $3.00 registration fees for each period of 6 months. It appears that, if an employment is found for an applicant thus registered, he must pay to the Bureau 10% of his first monthly wages or a lump sum the amount of which is agreed upon by the parties concerned. The majority of the clients are reported to be of the Russian nationality.
